prompt:
Edit this concept board, preserving its four-view composition (two desktop pages and two mobile pages), media-first gallery layout, real provided imagery, spacing, all section positions, and Ukrainian content. Only make the following targeted corrections, and render a polished final board “A · Медіавітрина”.
1. STRICT brand tokens: every DARK page has flat #0C0D0C background, no green gradients/glow. All headings/main text #EDEFEA; all descriptions/intro/footer link text #9AA296, NEVER green. Active “Усі” filter and “Показати ще” button in dark are #EDEFEA with #0F110F text. In LIGHT pages active filter and main button are flat #0F110F with white text. Green is reserved for Class logo and Каталог, small icons and Співпраця only. Play icons can be neutral ink in white circles.
2. Preserve the complete actual desktop shell: small top row city “Україна, м. Харків” plus info links, UA/RU/theme; main row logo, green Каталог, search, phone, small messenger/map/account/cart icons; category row EXACT Ukrainian “Завіси · Замки · Ручки · Циліндри · Міжкімнатні механізми · Інше · Двері · Регіони · Співпраця”. Keep all labels readable and compact. Mobile shell remains as it is.
3. Footer link groups must include “Каталог”, “Компанія”, “Покупцям”, “Контакти”; a small brand mark can accompany them but must not replace a link group. No invented cities, contact details or links.
4. Keep REAL media from supplied existing video stills; do not introduce new hardware objects or imaginary product shots. If a new photographic slot cannot reuse one of the supplied images faithfully, use a neutral image panel with a camera icon instead. Photo/video labels indicate demonstration placement; no fake durations or metrics.
5. Keep H1 “Галерея та відео”. Keep the board note “Приклади медіа — кадри з наявних відео”. Everything in Ukrainian, calm Onest Cyrillic typography. Preserve all four visible views, do not zoom or crop the board.
generationHistory:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a crisp, high-fidelity CONCEPT REVIEW BOARD for the Class Kedr public door-hardware website, with four complete page views arranged horizontally: desktop Ukrainian LIGHT, desktop Ukrainian DARK, narrow mobile Ukrainian LIGHT, narrow mobile Ukrainian DARK. Landscape canvas about 2560x1700; desktop views twice the width of each mobile; all four visible, no device frames, generous outer review-board margin. Small board title “A · Медіавітрина”.
Reference 1 is the user's approved brand/chrome reference ONLY: inherit Onest Cyrillic typography, sober shadcn styling, black/white backgrounds, restrained brand green #3FA435, thin borders, 8–12px radii. Do not copy the returns-page content or boxed information layout. Dark background #0C0D0C; green body text #7DD06F, light green text #2A7323.
References 2–4 are REAL photographs from the site's existing videos. Use these media images faithfully as content examples, cropping letterbox bars where appropriate. Do not invent, stylize, or draw hardware. These are demonstration media, not factual new product claims.
Keep the desktop website shell: city + information links + UA/RU/theme; Class Kedr logo, green “Каталог”, search, phone, messaging/account/cart controls; category navigation. Mobile: hamburger/logo/account/cart then separate search.
New content is an image-led mixed gallery: breadcrumb; H1 “Галерея та відео”; short line “Деталі, фактури та огляди дверної фурнітури”; format buttons “Усі”, “Фото”, “Відео”, with “Усі” active in ink. Lead composition: a wide video poster of the real hinge from reference 3, clear central play, small “Відео” label; beside it two smaller photographic media tiles from references 2/4. Concise captions BELOW images, never huge marketing overlays. Below, a regular mixed grid with explicit “Фото” or play/“Відео” format labels. No durations, metrics, dates, testimonials, fake product names, or installation-service claims. Ink “Показати ще” button and compact four-column footer. On phones preserve media order, single-column editorial lead then compact subsequent tiles; readable labels, comfortable tap targets. Make the SAME design recognizably consistent in all four views, with a distinct media rhythm and restrained chrome. All visible content in Ukrainian. Tiny review-board note outside pages: “Приклади медіа — кадри з наявних відео”.
